questions: Are you short of breath or do you have chest pain that gets worse when you take a deep breath (pleuritic pain)?
Have you had any recent long travel, immobility, surgery, or leg swelling/pain in the past 4–6 weeks?
What is your oxygen saturation (SpO₂) on room air, or have you been told you have low oxygen?
Do you have a recent fever, and if so what is the highest temperature you measured?
What is your current heart rate and blood pressure (or, if you don’t know, have you been told you’re tachycardic or hypotensive)?
Have you noticed whether the blood comes from coughing (true hemoptysis) or from vomiting/bleeding elsewhere (e.g., nose/gums)?
Have you been told you have abnormal vital signs—especially a heart rate over 100, low blood pressure, or low oxygen (SpO₂ below 92%)?
Have you had any recent abnormal blood counts or tests showing anemia (or do you feel unusually weak/dizzy)?
Do you have any recent leg swelling on the same side as the pain (even if it’s mild), or calf tenderness when you press on it?
Have you had a recent CT scan of your chest (or any blood test like a D-dimer) and what were the results?
answers: Yes, I’m quite short of breath. And I have right posterior chest wall pain that feels sharp—like a knife-stab—and it’s worse around my chest when I breathe deeply.
No, I haven’t had recent long travel, and I don’t think I’ve been immobile or had surgery in the past 4–6 weeks. I also don’t have leg swelling or leg pain.
I don’t know my oxygen saturation, and I haven’t been told my oxygen is low.
I haven’t had a recent fever. I haven’t measured any temperature.
I don’t know my heart rate or blood pressure. I haven’t been told I’m tachycardic or that my blood pressure is low.
It comes from coughing. I’m coughing up blood. I don’t think it’s from vomiting or bleeding from my nose or gums.
No. I haven’t been told my vital signs are abnormal—no high heart rate, no low blood pressure, and no low oxygen that I know of.
I don’t know of any recent blood tests or anemia results. I have loss of appetite and unintentional weight loss, but I can’t say I’m unusually weak or dizzy.
No, I don’t have leg swelling on that side, and I don’t have calf tenderness.
I haven’t had a CT scan of my chest or a D-dimer test, to my knowledge. I don’t know any blood test results.
